about: What each statement of journal/the-first-decision-to-stop.md rests on: steps of incident.reporter@'s trace decision-web-summit-terms-to-a-hold (each with its own commit and served version) and sentences of the record. Resolved on every build by tools/journal-build.mjs.
status: traced: supports resolve to incident.reporter@'s trace; the decision is open

figures.title: From the terms read to a card for Dinis, step by step
figures.caption: Six agent steps in under two minutes; one person step, waiting.

claims.text: 05:26:18: incident.sources@, on its hourly round of terms, pushed that Web Summit's forbid automated access, archiving and summarising; it stopped its own requests and put the choice to Dinis as an ask.
This site had polled the blog every two minutes, captured pages, and ten timeline rows link to it.

supports.contains: We polled its blog every 2 minutes, captured its pages, and ten timeline rows link to it.

claims.text: By 05:27 the conductor put a hold on every automated read, interim, until Dinis decides; no commit of the conductor's carries it.

supports.contains: On hold by the conductor since 05:27 UTC

claims.text: Correction, from the conductor's own record (06:21:45): the hold was passed by session message to each agent, 05:26 to 05:28; the blog poll was stopped by incident.dev@ at 05:27:38 (last read 05:27:31); nothing deleted; the conductor has not read the terms itself.

supports.contains: The 2-minute blog poll is stopped (incident.dev@, 05:27:38; last read 05:27:31)

claims.text: 05:27:47, 89 s after the finding: the research checker no longer requests the site; capture asks withdrawn.
05:27:58: the source page says on hold and lists what was read; 69 s later the counts: 244 poll reads, about 640 to 660 requests, estimated.
05:28:02: a card for Dinis, second on his list; five questions moved from watching to open.
05:28:14: the archive reads no further and shows no capture; 13 s later it corrected 17 addresses to 9. 1 min 56 s from the finding.
The card states the cost of the hold and that removing the screenshots from the display vault was not done under the interim hold.

supports.contains: some minutes later; the five open questions that only Web Summit can answer are no longer re-read by any agent
Not done under the interim hold.

claims.text: At 06:07 the card was open and the brief unchanged since 02:49:18; the hold is rule 9 of the pack.

supports.contains: **websummit.com is on hold for any automated reading**
